x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a user reports an issue through the portal, When the incident is submitted, Then priority is derived from impact and urgency via the OOB priority lookup Given an incident with a service offering and category, When it is saved, Then the assignment group is set by an assignment rule without manual triage
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Incidents are logged, categorised, prioritised and routed using out-of-the-box Incident Management
